clusters.title: Palantir has created bespoke tech solutions for the NHS | Letter
clusters.neutral_headline: Palantir has created bespoke tech solutions for the NHS | Letter

items.title: Palantir has created bespoke tech solutions for the NHS | Letter
items.standfirst: Stephen Childs responds to a letter that said the US software firm was not the right fit for Britain’s health serviceProf Caroline Mitchell is right that US systems designed for an insurance market are rife in the NHS (Letters, 18 November). But Palantir’s software isn’t among them – and should not be confused with a range of other systems, some designed as far back as the 1970s for billing and then exported to the NHS over the following decades.Our story is different. Each application built on the federated data platform – which connects information across the NHS – is bespoke to the NHS and to the healthcare trust that uses it. The NHS is a highly complex, loose association of healthcare trusts and commissioners, with data that is rich, but often unstructured and frustratingly disconnected. Continue reading...

items.title: Alison Walton-Robson obituary
items.standfirst: My friend Alison Walton-Robson, who has died aged 61 of ovarian cancer, was a tireless campaigner for the disability arts movement. Latterly she was the creative director of Headway Arts in Blyth, Northumberland, a pioneering inclusive organisation she co-founded in 1995. Headway offers people from all backgrounds the chance to contribute to the cultural life of their communities and to realise their full creative potential.The company, which became an Arts Council England national portfolio organisation in 2023, pays particular attention to providing opportunities for artists who are neurodivergent or have a learning disability, and has built an impressive portfolio of projects, including international collaborations. Allie was proud to be an Erasmus+ ambassador and contributed a case study to the European Movement’s successful campaign for the UK to rejoin the EU Erasmus+ education and training programme. Continue reading...
